ANCHOR-001.cause: the historical feeder admitted a daily bar by `stamp + 24h <= UTC midnight of t`. A daily bar is stamped at the session's ET midnight (04:00Z under EDT), so the most recent completed session failed the test and the one before it was returned.
ANCHOR-001.repair: select by SESSION DATE: the last session strictly before the session containing the as-of instant (apex.pulse.anchors.select_prior_daily)

ANCHOR-002.cause: the intraday window began at UTC midnight, which is 20:00 ET on the PREVIOUS calendar day, so dailyBar.o was the first extended-hours print. Astra's correction is confirmed: cash_open_return_bps is mid/dailyBar.o and has nothing to do with prior_close.
ANCHOR-002.repair: the aggregate covers the REGULAR session only, and the opening price comes from the current session's daily bar through a field allow-list of exactly ('o',)

anchor_decomposition.buckets: semantically_equivalent = both feeders produced a value and they agree; disagreed = both produced a value and they do not; not_compared = history produced nothing, which is a COVERAGE question, not a value question

pure_anchor_quantities.result: EXACT on every subject where history reconstructed anything (5 of 6 subjects); the only gap is NKLA, where history reconstructs nothing at all. ANCHOR-001 and ANCHOR-002 no longer produce a wrong value anywhere.

anchor_over_live_mid.note: these embed the LIVE MID as well as an anchor, so a quote-timing difference surfaces here even when the anchor itself is exact. On AAOI the two pure anchor quantities match EXACTLY while these two do not, which localises the residual to the mid rather than to the anchor.

anchor_decomposition.why_the_overall_verdict_is_not_PASS: ANCHOR_REPAIR is computed under the strict rule fixed before the run -- all four anchor-related fields SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT on every subject. AAOI disagrees on the two mid-bearing features and NKLA compares nothing at all, so the rule is not met. The rule was NOT relaxed after seeing the result; the decomposition is offered so the residual can be judged rather than assumed.

AAL.finding: both feeders read the same SIP NBBO with the same convention; they select DIFFERENT events because the live packet's quote is the one current when PULSE captured (1.405s after the scheduled slot) while the replay reconstructs at the scheduled slot exactly. 7 NBBO updates fall between them.

AAPL.finding: both feeders read the same SIP NBBO with the same convention; they select DIFFERENT events because the live packet's quote is the one current when PULSE captured (1.298s after the scheduled slot) while the replay reconstructs at the scheduled slot exactly. 30 NBBO updates fall between them.

NKLA.finding: the live packet carries no two-sided NBBO at all; nothing to compare. Coverage question, not a value question.

residual_after_repair.conclusion: category (a) on every subject that had a quote: same source, same convention, DIFFERENT selected event.
